objective: A buyer or seller deciding whether to hand this shop the largest transaction of their life. The page completes when they tap a broker name, a phone number, or a text link — the next act is a person, never a form.

Where do they work, and do they know MY area?

Verified Google reviews with their record (count, average, newest) from the same getReviews read /reviews uses — one derivation, not a second set of quotes.

Per-figure verification traces. The 2026-05-13 audit found no local competitor publishes source, table, filter and row count beside a market figure; it also found the three rivals publishing a Bend median for the same July disagreed by 04K with no methodology stated.

The rival carries 600+ blog posts since 2015 (~12/month in 2026) feeding internal links into its brand pages. /about receives no comparable internal link flow.
As of the 2026-05-13 SERP sweep, ryan-realty.com appeared on 0 of the 10 canonical commercial queries while this rival appeared on 5.

visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by leading with verified facts, a concrete origin, live city inventory, and direct-broker doors. Zero marketing-speak except the locked D11 mission sentence.
note: Look 2026-08-14: About = faces. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (live broker cutouts, compact H1, name door, Call and Text on the face row), Quiet (origin facts only), Instrument (founded / firm license / principal broker, no seller ask), Atlas (the service area as the living map, from buildPlaceAtlas), Proof (the newest reviews), Quiet (locked D11 mission below the fold, then FAQ and edges), Footer. PUBLIC_UI.md opens About on Quiet + Sheet. Faces are Stage's job (owned media) without V3Stage's full-bleed frame, which would box the transparent PNGs. The family's Sheet lives on /contact and /team/[slug]. A new on-page form here would be a new capture contract. Seller lives on Sell. The next tap is the name or the number. D11: the mission sentence is the one virtue-word exception, exact words, We, and it does not ship on the first screen. City rows skip a missing median rather than printing zero under a live-MLS source line. Dates render in Pacific through formatDate. KB-era deletions this migration made: KbHero (including property search), KbAbout, KbExploreTowns, KbTestimonials, KbArticles, KbSell, KbTeam (already removed from this page 2026-07-08), FAQBlock, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css import.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: First viewport. Live brokers from getBrokers, canonical /images/brokers/*.png cutouts at conversation scale (card-photo token, not a 70vh yearbook). Name is the door to /team/[slug]. Title, Call, and Text sit under the portrait from the live broker phone and title. No card, no wash, no rectangular box. Compact H1 lives here. No eyebrow, no mission graf.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, ONCE (2026-09-02, was twice). After the faces, below the fold: origin facts (Matt, fire service, Red Erickson, June 2023), doors to /team /reviews /contact. The closing block moved to V3Answers.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with the three edges /about has not offered yet (Value my home, Homes for sale, Central Oregon housing market) in the left rail. Replaces the closing V3Quiet 2026-09-02: as prose it measured 1,491px at 1440 with 8 paragraphs, no figure and no control, which is the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name, and four of those paragraphs restated a section above them. The D11 mission sentence went with them — VOICE.md permits it on About and requires it nowhere, and it opened on smallness positioning. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, once. Founded date, firm license OREA 201253677, principal broker license linking /team/matthew-ryan. Source line names Oregon Real Estate Agency. No seller ask on this Instrument. Seller lives on Sell. The valuation door stays a Quiet link in the closing FAQ.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
